title: Deploy live learner site (static hosting) + canonical attribution
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). A site that only exists on a developer's machine has not delivered on the 'zero install, zero account' promise. Deploying to a stable public URL completes the M2 Definition of Done and is a prerequisite for partner adoption.
objective: Deploy the static learner site to a stable public hosting environment, set up a canonical URL, and add canonical attribution that satisfies the CC-BY license requirement for the corpus.
acceptanceCriteria: Static site is deployed to a public, stable URL accessible by learners without login or install.
Deployment is automated via CI on every merge to main.
Canonical attribution for the CC-BY prose is present on every lesson page (author list, license link, source URL).
HTTPS is enforced; no learner data is transmitted to the server (static hosting only).
The public URL is recorded in the repository README and in the corpus provenance manifest.
output: A merged PR and a live learner site at a public URL with automated deployment, HTTPS, and canonical attribution on all lesson pages.
